293 T WT and 293 T SIRT6 KO cells stably expressing CDH1-HA were lysed and subjected to anti-HA immunoprecipitation. IP samples were separated by SDS-PAGE and bands of CDH1-HA were sliced, in-gel digested, and subjected to LC–MS/MS analysis.
